svg.title: ToolCall execution loop
svg.desc: Start with context; Request model; Tool calls present?; Run tools in order: Tool errors become results; Check outcome; Append tool results; Pause for input; Finish. start → model; model → calls; calls → tools: Yes; calls → end: No; tools → result; result → append: Continue; append → model: Next turn; result → pause: Interaction; result → end: Stop; model → end: Request error

g.font-family: Arial, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif
